author: Claire Dupont
content: Outlook keeps crashing when I open attachments larger than 10MB

author: David Chen
content: Try disabling hardware acceleration in Outlook settings

author: Claire Dupont
content: That fixed it, hardware acceleration was the issue!

author: Emma Rousseau
content: Can't access shared drive Z: getting access denied error since the update

author: Frank Martin
content: Try disconnecting and reconnecting the network drive

author: Emma Rousseau
content: Still denied. IT reset my permissions and it works now

author: George Lambert
content: Printer on floor 3 not showing up in available printers list

author: Helen Petit
content: Restart the print spooler service and try adding it again

author: George Lambert
content: Restarting spooler worked, printer is visible now thanks
